11870|3a5c3d7e.name: Archibald
11870|3a5c3d7e.text: I suppose you are here to be trained in the use of a new weapon?  Make it fast, I'm very busy!

14729|9e055276.name: Ralston Farnsley
14729|9e055276.text:
You there... it is in your best interest to aid the Forsaken during these dire times.  Listen closely, as I dislike repeating myself.

We currently find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  Bandages and simple textiles are running low, and donations are being accepted to bolster sagging inventories.  While you'll not receive financial compensation - hence what donation means - your aid will not go unnoticed.

1498|62922c99.name: Bethor Iceshard
1498|62922c99.text:
The struggle for freedom against the Scourge is constant, and yet they are not our only foes.  Our chance in survival lies in shrewd politics, research, and brutal exploitation of our enemy's weaknesses.

If you are ready, then we will talk.

1937|19122c56.name: Apothecary Renferrel
1937|19122c56.text: The Dark Lady has put the challenge forth. Now it is up to the Royal Apothecary Society to develop a new plague. We shall bring Arthas and his wretched army to their knees.

1938|cd4928e4.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1938|cd4928e4.text: The Kirin Tor did not heed my warnings! The Alliance is a sham. Arugal is a reckless fool.

2121|bf7b697c.name: Shadow Priest Allister
2121|bf7b697c.text: Information... With our scouts and agents, we control the flow of information in Lordaeron. Scourge movements, their holdings, all underneath our watchful eyes...

2215|dc484bb4.name: High Executor Darthalia
2215|dc484bb4.text: In order to serve the Dark Lady and Varimathras we need to advance the front on the Human Infestation.

2216|8e0e34da.name: Apothecary Lydon
2216|8e0e34da.text: We are but so close to developing the New Plague that our Dark Lady desires with such fervor.

2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

2238|6d472bad.name: Tog'thar
2238|6d472bad.text: Get away from here, $c, or they'll put you in chains as well.

2389|c5ceacbe.name: Zarise
2389|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2391|5dffcf15.name: Serge Hinott
2391|5dffcf15.text: Another interruption. How am I supposed to get any work done like this? Don't answer that; do I look as if I care what you have to say? Why don't you go bother Mr. High-And-Mighty instead?

260093|08830bac.name: Garen Largo
260093|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

260093|58279558.name: Garen Largo
260093|58279558.text: Do you require training in the ways of the light?

2934|2cd97b51.name: Keeper Bel'dugur
2934|2cd97b51.text: Knowledge is both tool and weapon to those with the will to use it.

3539|8259246a.name: Ott
3539|8259246a.text:
My blades don't glisten, glitter, or gleam, and they'll sing no epic songs about my creations when I'm gone. 

One thing you can be sure of though is that my weapons will cut down all the knights in Stormwind before losing their honed edge.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4596|b22b0c37.name: James Van Brunt
4596|b22b0c37.text: How is the edge of your steel? Good enough to cut through the belly of your enemy? Let me show you some things to make it even sharper.

4605|e9a5758c.name: Basil Frye
4605|e9a5758c.text: You have learned much, more than I can teach. Go to James Van Brunt, he will teach you what I cannot.

5819|88989ac8.name: Mirelle Tremayne
5819|88989ac8.text:
If you're looking for plate armor, mail armor or shields, I've got the finest in all of Undercity. Most of these pieces are made and repaired here locally, though some are scavenged.

Feel free to browse.

6741|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

78127-complete.name: Owen Thadd
78127-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78127-complete.title: The Dalaran Digest

78127-progress.name: Owen Thadd
78127-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78127-progress.title: The Dalaran Digest

7813-progress.name: Ralston Farnsley
7813-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Undercity for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7813-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

79096-complete.name: Owen Thadd
79096-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
79096-complete.title: Ataeric: On Arcane Curiosities

79096-progress.name: Owen Thadd
79096-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79096-progress.title: Ataeric: On Arcane Curiosities

95883-accept.name: Unknown
95883-accept.text:
<The preparations for a hastily-assembled ritual are gathered unceremoniously on the altar. According to the scrap of note, everything has been gathered. All that's missing are the offering of blood and the Tortured Soul.

The $r around you look tortured enough. They may have what you seek.>
95883-accept.title: The Tortured Soul

95883-complete.name: Unknown
95883-complete.text:
<The tortured soul lets out a foul energy in the presence of the offering stone.

It appears you are closer to fulfilling the ritual.>
95883-complete.title: The Tortured Soul

95884-accept.name: Unknown
95884-accept.text:
<The scrap of note is mostly illegible. What is still readable, however, are notes about preparations for an offering.

An offering stone is mentioned, as well as a ritual.

Perhaps you can find this offering stone nearby.>
95884-accept.title: The Offering Stone

95884-complete.name: Unknown
95884-complete.text:
<Strange implements and items litter the rough surface of the stone.

This is surely the offering stone that is mentioned in the note.>
95884-complete.title: The Offering Stone

95885-accept.name: Unknown
95885-accept.text:
<All that's left now is the offering of blood.

The note scrap mentioned a 'willing sacrifice.'

An intense sense of dread washes over you.>
95885-accept.title: The Offering of Blood

95885-complete.name: Unknown
95885-complete.text:
<The offering stone is inert now. It appears your ritual drained it of power. To what end, you do not know, but it is over now.

The rough stone cracks and crumbles, now devoid of purpose.

Something glitters from within the remnants...>
95885-complete.title: The Offering of Blood
